notes_zh: ⚡ 语音输入提速：本地转写 + 标点改多线程推理，松手后出字更跟手 + ⌨️ 托盘新增统一快捷键设置：召唤 AI 快捷键（之前只能在 onboarding 设）和语音触发键一处切换、热切换不用重启 + 🐭 修连续语音输入时桌宠被拽回角落的跳动。安装包仍 12 MB。
notes_en: ⚡ Faster dictation: multi-threaded local ASR + punctuation for snappier output on release + ⌨️ Unified shortcut settings in the tray: switch the summon hotkey (was onboarding-only) and the voice trigger key in one place, hot-swapped with no restart + 🐭 Fixed the pet jumping back to its corner during rapid dictation. Still a 12 MB DMG.
